subject: Discovery follow-up: model scorecard, diffs & contingency pin request
messages:
From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir.patel@lighthouseai.com>, Priya Rao <priya@lighthouseai.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 3 Sep 2026 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Discovery follow-up: model scorecard, diffs & contingency pin request

Hi Samir / Priya — thanks again for the call today. Quick recap of the things we promised and an emergent concern we observed when re-running your benchmark:  

High-level recap
- Target use case: customer support response generation for billing & refunds (short, factual responses, high precision).
- Dataset sample: 1.2k customer tickets + synthetic edge cases you shared.
- Preliminary best-fit model: rdx-mid-q4 (fast, lower cost) for throughput tests; rdx-large-ptq for quality QA.

What we ran after the call
- Re-ran your golden set (200 prompts) against the production variant you were demoing (rdx-large-v2, rolled on 2026-09-01) and compared to rdx-large-v1 snapshots we had saved. Results attached: lighthouse_eval_summary.csv.
- Observed a measurable uptick in "hallucination-like" completions on billing edge cases (precision drop ~6.8% on Key Entity Extraction checks). We added a short diff example in diff-snippet.txt for one ticket where the v2 output introduced an extra charge that wasn't supported by the ticket text.

Attachments included:
- lighthouse_eval_summary.csv (summary metrics + per-example outputs)
- prompt_set_lighthouse_v1.jsonl (golden prompts + expected goldens)
- diff-snippet.txt (short quoted diffs for 3 failing examples)

Recommended immediate actions (proposal)
1) Snapshot & pin: create an enforced snapshot for your account pointing at rdx-large-v1 for the next 72 hours while we investigate. This prevents further drift impacting your live tests.
2) Deep diff: run the full 1.2k set diff job (we can queue; estimate 3–4 hours on dedicated infra).
3) Quick mitigation: configure a conservative top_p/temperature profile + stricter extraction rules we recommend for billing intents.

Can you confirm whether you want us to open an emergency pin for Lighthouse AI now? If yes we will: (a) raise a support ticket, (b) snapshot the v1 id, (c) deploy a canary of the updated safety profile to your dev route only.

Next steps I propose:
- Samir/Priya: confirm 'pin now' or 'investigate first' by EOD PT.
- Karthik/Marissa: if approved, please follow the emergency pin playbook below and point to the related links.

Thanks — I know time is sensitive here.

Best,
Irene
Irene Choi
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
irene.choi@redwoodinference.com | +1 415-555-0123
[Attachment: lighthouse_eval_summary.csv (CSV, 124 KB)]
[Attachment: prompt_set_lighthouse_v1.jsonl (JSONL, 48 KB)]
[Attachment: diff-snippet.txt (TXT, 3 KB)]

From: Samir Patel <samir.patel@lighthouseai.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodinference.com>, Priya Rao <priya@lighthouseai.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 3 Sep 2026 15:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Discovery follow-up: model scorecard, diffs & contingency pin request

Thanks Irene — we appreciate the quick run. The snippet is concerning. For context, we were running dev traffic only but several of our QA users hit the new behavior and flagged it.

We'd prefer a short pin while you dig in — the risk of customer-facing regressions during our sandbox soak is higher than keeping the older snapshot. Please go ahead and open the emergency pin for 72 hours. Also please include the mitigation steps (temperature/top_p) you mentioned so our SREs can mirror them in the dev route.

Priya and I are available on a quick screen-share if you want to walk through the three failing examples around 16:00 PT.

Samir
Samir Patel
Head of Product | Lighthouse AI
samir.patel@lighthouseai.com

On Thu, Sep 3, 2026 at 2:05 PM Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodinference.com> wrote:
> Hi Samir / Priya — thanks again for the call today. Quick recap...

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 3 Sep 2026 16:02:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Discovery follow-up: model scorecard, diffs & contingency pin request

Irene / Marissa — thanks for the signal. Headline plan from ops:  

Immediate (hours)
- Approve emergency pin to rdx-large-v1 for account DL-2026-3243 (72-hour window). This is a safe, reversible change.
- Add traffic filter: route 100% of current dev tokens to the pinned snapshot, but keep production isolated.

Investigation (24–72 hours)
- Full diff run on the 1.2k set (we'll attach per-example logs). Assign to @marissa for triage.
- Check compilation/kernel mismatch notes: v2 includes an LMF token-mapping improvement that can slightly alter spacing/quoting; that can cascade into extraction heuristics.
- If diff shows systematic extraction shifts, we escalate to runtime team and prepare a targeted micro-rollout with adjusted decoding params.

Operator steps (what I need from Irene)
- Confirm support ticket creation (INC-89712). Use urgency: P1 account-facing potential regression.
- Provide the three worst examples (diff-snippet already has them) and mark them as reproduction steps.

I'll queue the emergency pin once Irene confirms — Marissa, please prepare the extended diff job and collect the per-example outputs in a CSV.

Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Director, Inference Ops | Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com

[Suggested mitigation params]
- temperature: 0.0–0.2
- top_p: 0.6
- max_tokens cap: 160
- extraction post-filter: strict entity threshold (confidence > 0.85)

From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir.patel@lighthouseai.com>, Priya Rao <priya@lighthouseai.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 3 Sep 2026 18:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Discovery follow-up: model scorecard, diffs & contingency pin request

Thanks all — Samir, we'll proceed with the emergency pin now per your approval. Summary of actions I just kicked off:

1) Support ticket created: INC-89712 (P1) — https://support.redwoodinference.com/tickets/INC-89712
2) Emergency pin scheduled: snapshot -> rdx-large-v1, 72-hour window starting 2026-09-03T18:30:00-07:00. Dev route traffic redirected to pinned snapshot.
3) Marissa: diff job queued against the full 1.2k set; ETA 3.5 hours; results will be uploaded to the Drive folder.
4) Ops mitigation: applied conservative decoding params to the dev route (temp 0.1 / top_p 0.6) per Karthik's suggestion.

Next steps for Lighthouse AI
- Please confirm whether you want Redwood to also apply the same conservative profile to your staging/prod mirror. If yes, we need an explicit sign-off (security/ops/yours).
- If you'd like a screen-share to walk the three failing cases, I'm available at 19:00 PT; otherwise, I'll wait for your notes in the Drive doc.

I'll follow up with the diff CSV and a short triage memo once Marissa posts outputs.

Best,
Irene
Irene Choi
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
irene.choi@redwoodinference.com
